doc: The nodes of the game's skill tree: what each costs in skill points, how many levels it has, its kind and class, and the ability it unlocks.

ids.mod: (none: a mod adds nodes through kiln.skills)
ids.rule: A node has no debug name: it is game:skill_<its 32-bit node id as 8 hex digits> (game:skill_4475e8dd), the name Kiln's skills data-pack section and catalogs already give it. Nodes a mod adds through Kiln's skill tree service are not entries: their definition holds their cost.

cost.doc: The skill points one unlock costs (each level of a node with levels costs it again). The game counts it at every unlock, at every join and at a respec: a character whose unlocked nodes now cost more than their skill points gets the game's free reset of the whole tree at their next join.

maxLevel.doc: How many levels the node has: 0 is one unlock, 1 to 7 are levels. Read-only: a character's saved level above it would reset the whole tree at the next join, and a node without levels has no level slot.

kind.doc: The node's kind: a root of the tree, an attribute, an active skill (it unlocks an ability) or a passive skill.

class.doc: The class the node belongs to (its colour on the skill screen).

unlocks.doc: The ability item the node unlocks; absent for every node that unlocks none.
